csv_project_name: DB for SABER Westover Air Reserve Base
csv_scope_of_work: To design and construct project YTPM 25-0005, Repair ATCALS, Building 5505 at Westover Air Reserve Base. The Contractor is responsible for the incidental design and construction work described in this Statement of Objective. The objective of this project is to renovate/repair several features of Bldg. 5505. The areas of concern include: roof replacement, new flooring, new lighting, exterior/interior painting, bathroom fixture replacement, lighting upgrades, installation of two mini-split systems and the replacement of two motorized dampers.
